notes.title: 1.2.1 small fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed mission 1A victory/defeat conditions
[*] Fixed lookout all button on stressed units
[*] Removed the multiplayer chatbox in skirmish menu
[/list]

[list]
[*] French Localization for Interface (not the story mode)
[*] Buildings can now be destroyed by artillery or tank gun fire, be careful!
[*] "Activate lookout on all capable units" button
[*] [b][i]Experimental [/i][/b]Multiplayer (don't advertised it as a feature, we made it public because it *mostly* works but don't expect it to be a smooth experience)
[*] Map previews for skirmish
[/list]

CHANGELOG 1.1.0

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Major bug in army management has been fixed.
[*] Resolved the save bug issue.
[*]Fixed an invisible cold effect problem.
[*]Corrected an issue where attacks were being charged twice during the same turn.
[*]Addressed UI scaling at startup for smaller resolutions.
[*]Fixed the problem where music did not restart from the beginning in a new game.
[*]Ensured the correct resolution is selected in options after a restart.
[*]Other Small fixes.
[/list]
New Features and Enhancements:
[list]
[*] Added two new battle music tracks.
[*] Included additional information for missing attacks.
[*] Adjusted the volume of sound effects when far from the camera.
[*] Implemented new artillery animations.
[/list]

CHANGELOG 1.0.1
[list]
[*] Camera can now rotate.
[*] Buff to medicaments efficiency.
[*] Buff to tank accuracy and toughness.
[*] Buff to bonuses when killing enemies in campaign. (1>1.25)
[*] Nerf to maluses when your troops were killed in campaign. (0.75>0.6)
[*] Malus to fleeing unit's wellbeing in next phase.
[*] Fix non-playing move animation when enemy first enters sight.
[*] Other Small fixes.
[/list]

(Une localisation française est en préparation)
